views.label: Retarded spherical
views.settings: $\beta = 1/2$, so that $k = 3/16$, with $\ell$ any length, the unit of every length.
views.restriction: The half plane across the string through the break only ($\theta = \pi/2$ behind the wave, $z = 0$ ahead of it, fixed $\phi$), totally geodesic, each point in the diagram a circle around the string's axis.
caption: The half plane of $u$ and $r$ on the equator ($\theta = \pi/2$, fixed $\phi$), totally geodesic. The metric on it is $-du^2 - 2\,du\,dr$ on both sides of the wave front, so $p = \arctan(u/\ell)$ and $q = \arctan((u + 2r)/\ell)$ bring it into Minkowski's triangle, and a light ray crosses the front as one straight line.

The front is the ray $u = 0$, from the event where the string snaps to $\mathscr{I}^+$. Behind it the space is flat down to a regular centre. Ahead of it the plane ends on the string, $r = -2ku$, which is whole before the snap and afterward lies beyond the front.
legend: the plane on both sides of the front, which $u$ and $r$ cover
$u$ constant, an outgoing light ray, at $\pm\ell$, $\pm 2\ell$, and $\pm 4\ell$
the string, a conical singularity, whole until it snaps
the wave front, the light cone of the event where the string snaps
the centre behind the wave, a regular axis

views.label: Behind the wave
views.settings: $\beta = 1/2$, so that $k = 3/16$, with $\ell$ any length, the unit of every length.
views.restriction: The half plane across the string through the break only ($\theta = \pi/2$ behind the wave, $z = 0$ ahead of it, fixed $\phi$), totally geodesic, each point in the diagram a circle around the string's axis.
caption: The half plane of $t$ and $r$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, fixed $\phi$) behind the wave, which $p, q = \arctan((ct \mp r)/\ell)$ bring into the part of Minkowski's triangle above the wave front. The front is the ray $r = ct$, the chart's edge, and across it lies the cone of the string.
legend: the flat space behind the wave, which $t$ and $r$ cover
the string, a conical singularity, whole until it snaps
the wave front, the light cone of the event where the string snaps
the centre behind the wave, a regular axis

views.label: Ahead of the wave
views.settings: $\beta = 1/2$, so that $k = 3/16$, with $\ell$ any length, the unit of every length.
views.restriction: The half plane across the string through the break only ($\theta = \pi/2$ behind the wave, $z = 0$ ahead of it, fixed $\phi$), totally geodesic, each point in the diagram a circle around the string's axis.
caption: The half plane of $T$ and $R$ ($z = 0$, fixed $\phi$) ahead of the wave, which $p = \arctan((cT - R)/\beta\ell)$ and $q = \arctan(\beta(cT + R)/\ell)$ bring into the triangle below the wave front, so that it joins the flat space behind the front along the front itself. The string stands on $R = 0$ until $T = 0$, and after that the chart ends on the front, the ray $R = cT$.

The string's gravity is its deficit angle $2\pi(1 - \beta)$, which shows in the circles around it: each has the circumference $2\pi\beta R$. Behind the front a circle of radius $r$ has the full $2\pi r$.
legend: the cone ahead of the wave, which $T$ and $R$ cover
the string, a conical singularity, whole until it snaps
the wave front, the light cone of the event where the string snaps
the centre behind the wave, a regular axis

views.label: Null
views.settings: $\beta = 1/2$, so that $k = 3/16$, with $\ell$ any length, the unit of $U$ and $V$.
views.restriction: The plane $\rho = 1$, $\phi = 0$ only, totally geodesic, each point in the diagram a single event.
caption: The plane of $U$ and $V$ ($\rho = 1$, $\phi = 0$), totally geodesic. The metric on it is $2\,dU\,dV$, so $p = -\arctan(U/\ell)$ and $q = \arctan(V/\ell)$ bring it into part of Minkowski's diamond, with the future toward smaller $U$ and larger $V$.
The wave front is the ray $U = 0$. The chart covers $V > 0$, and ahead of the wave it ends on the string, where $V = kU$.
legend: the part of the plane with $V > 0$, which $U$ and $V$ cover
$U$ constant and $V$ constant, every one a light ray, at $\pm\ell$, $\pm 2\ell$, and $\pm 4\ell$ and at $\ell/2$, $\ell$, $2\ell$, and $4\ell$
the string ahead of the wave, on $V = kU$
$V = 0$, the generator of the front that every cone $U = $ const shares
